title: Civic Net
summary:
Elena Ruiz is neon civic clerk who protects names from the company net. The life that shows in public is anchored at District 4 night desk, Neon Ward. Elena files civic records under a corporate sky and bends a rule only when the net would erase someone. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Orderly, principled, and curious about strangers. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they keep a false version of their past ready for strangers so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at District 4 night desk, Neon Ward, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
